# SheetJS CE

The archive xlsx-0.20.3.tgz is the unmodified upstream distribution fetched over HTTPS from https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz on 2026-11-05.

The official installation guide identifies this CDN as the authoritative source and recommends vendoring: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/nodejs/ . Keeping the archive here makes deployments reproducible without depending on the availability of the CDN. The upstream license is included inside the archive.
